# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1611
- **Title**: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1611
- **Title**: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).

- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

warn() {
  printf '\033[1;33m!\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

err() {
  printf '\033[1;31m✘\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else
      prompt "$text [y/N]"
    fi
    if ! read -r answer < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
      printf '%s' "$default"
      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else
      prompt "$text [y/N]"
    fi
    if ! read -r answer < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
      printf '%s' "$default"
      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611

- **Title**: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else
      prompt "$text [y/N]"
    fi
    if ! read -r answer < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
      printf '%s' "$default"
      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

warn() {
  printf '\033[1;33m!\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2
}

err() {
  printf '\033[1;31m✘\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else
      prompt "$text [y/N]"
    fi

      printf '%s' "$default"
      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}

      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;

- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

Since `site/setup.sh` is golden-pinned, fix the template and rerun

### Thread 2 — `test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: lint calibration comment contradicts the repo's own platform-fact test**

This docstring line says `read -rs` is "sanctioned by the card — dash/busybox/bash all implement it". That is factually wrong for dash, and the repo now proves the opposite in
`test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart`:

test('dash read has no -s (why ask_hidden hides via stty)', () {

  expect(r.exitCode, isNonZero, ...);

```

No emitted artifact uses `read -s` anymore (the wizard hides input via
`stty -echo`), so the regex itself is fine — only the justification is
stale. Reword to something like: "`read -s` is not in the forbidden set
only because no artifact uses it; dash has no `-s` — hidden input is done
via `stty -echo` (see `ask_hidden`)".

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` regressed from `dart format`-clean to dirty**

`scripts/gen_installers.dart` is `dart format`-clean on `origin/main`; this PR's heavy edits leave it dirty (here and one more spot — a ternary that fits on one line in main's style). There is no CI format gate, but the repo's pre-commit hook self-heals staged files with `dart format`, so committing unformatted files just moves churn into the next author's staging diff. 9 of the 10 Dart files touched by this PR currently fail `dart format --set-exit-if-changed`.

  test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart \

Purely cosmetic (the golden test compares template output, not the
generator's own formatting), so no behavior risk.

### Thread 4 — `test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: ticket AC3 says the key lands in `config.yaml` exactly once — this (correctly) does not do that**

Ticket gh-1596 AC3 reads: "the hidden API key ... and `~/.fah/config.yaml` contains it exactly once." The implementation — and this assertion — deliberately keep `config.yaml` key-free and persist the key to the shell rc instead, per the settings-registry invariant (issue #288 E1, "secrets never ride the yaml", `lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart:227`). That is the architecturally correct choice, and it matches today's behavior on `main` (the old wizard never wrote the key to the yaml either) — but the deviation from the ticket's literal AC is only documented in test comments.

Please note it explicitly in the PR description (or amend gh-1596's AC3), so the ticket's acceptance record doesn't read as unmet. Everything else about AC3 holds and is well tested: the key appears in exactly one produced file, exactly once, byte-scanned across every file under the fixture HOME.

### Thread 5 — `site/setup.sh.template`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: predictable temp-file name is symlink-followable — `mktemp` is strictly safer**

`FAH_TMP_CONF="$FAH_CONFIG_DIR/.config.yaml.tmp"` is a fixed, predictable path, and the `> "$FAH_TMP_CONF"` redirect follows a pre-planted symlink. A local attacker who can write `$HOME/.fah` before the wizard runs could point that path at another user-writable file and get the config bytes written there. The risk is marginal (an attacker with write access to `~/.fah` can already clobber `config.yaml` itself), so this is hardening, not a blocker:

```sh

```

`mktemp` is POSIX-equivalent (GNU + busybox + BSD all support the template
form), keeps the EXIT-trap cleanup working, and removes the guessability.

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1611
- **Title**: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else
      prompt "$text [y/N]"
    fi
    if ! read -r answer < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
      printf '%s' "$default"
      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then

  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then

  else

  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else
      prompt "$text [y/N]"
    fi
    if ! read -r answer < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
      printf '%s' "$default"
      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611
