- **Title**: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`

- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else

    fi

      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then

  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then

  else

  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

content.text:
# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1555 (W1, lazy/windowed-everywhere reads): the legacy full-open call
  sites migrate to windowed opens, so a session ledger past the gh-1073
  2 GiB full-open backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path.
  The TUI session picker, `/resume`, and the boot name-resolution scan
  open windowed and resolve the display name through paged reads; the
  subagent transcript preview opens the child windowed (tail only); the
  `_loadSession` marathon fallback no longer degenerates to a refused
  full open when the boundary walk exhausts its page cap (it proceeds
  with the tail-anchored windowed session; the boot cap owns over-window
  residue); and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver opens windowed,
  reading the whole ledger for the cost/inspect views through the new
  `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident` — a sequential forward scan in
  bounded strips (`WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder`), not the
  boundary-walk's doubling strips (whose per-strip record cap measured
  ~13x read/parse amplification over the whole file). The same change
  block-prepends paged chunks in `_indexChunk` (one `insertAll` per
  list), removing an O(n²) the suspended-eviction walk paid per record.
  Trajectory export streaming (AC3a), split-and-retain rotation
  activation (W2), and the opt-in write-side caps (W3) remain follow-up
  work.

- gh-1605: the FinalizeGate gains a "grader parity" named check. A
  produced entry point (script/CLI the verifier will run itself) is only
  verified when it survives the grader's own invocation: the checklist
  must re-run each produced entry point from a different working
===

- **PR #**: 1611

- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on

prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"

  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then

}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,

  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi

  fi

  return 1
}

## Unreleased

- gh-1555 (W1, lazy/windowed-everywhere reads): the legacy full-open call

  2 GiB full-open backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# setup.sh — interactive configuration wizard for the Fa CLI.
#              Run this after `install.sh` to pick a provider, model, API key,
#              mode and approval policy.
#
#                curl -fsSL "https://fa1.dev/setup.sh" | sh
#
# What it does:
#   1. Verifies `fa` is installed.
#   2. Interactively picks a provider + model (or a custom endpoint).
#   3. Collects the API key and writes ~/.fah/config.yaml.
#   4. Optionally persists the API key in your shell startup file.
#
# {{GENERATED_HEADER}}

# gh-1596: this script runs under `curl | sh` — the shebang is dead text and
# whatever `sh` resolves to executes it. POSIX sh only (dash + busybox ash +
# bash): no `printf -v`, no `[[`, no arrays, no `read -p/-a/-N`, no
# `${var,,}`, no `=~`. UT-1 (test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart) lints
# the dialect; UT-2 pins the regenerated bytes.

set -eu  # no pipefail: dash (Ubuntu sh) lacks it

# E4: an unset HOME would die later inside the config path with a bare
# "parameter not set" — fail here, clearly, before anything else runs.
if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then
  printf '\033[1;31m✘\033[0m %s\n' '$HOME is not set — cannot write the Fa config. Set HOME and re-run.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

FAH_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.fah"
FAH_CONFIG_FILE="$FAH_CONFIG_DIR/config.yaml"
FAH_TMP_CONF=""  # config write is atomic (tmp + mv); cleaned on any exit
FAH_STTY_SAVED=""  # termios during hidden reads; restored on any exit

trap 'rm -f "$FAH_TMP_CONF"
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi' EXIT

# ── TTY handling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [ -t 0 ]; then
  FAH_TTY="/dev/stdin"
else
  FAH_TTY="/dev/tty"
fi

# ── Output helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
say() {
  printf '%s\n' "$*"
}

info() {
  printf '\033[1;34m→\033[0m %s\n' "$*"
}

ok() {
  printf '\033[1;32m✔\033[0m %s\n' "$*"
}

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1611
- **Title**: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer

    else

      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1555 (W1, lazy/windowed-everywhere reads): the legacy full-open call
  sites migrate to windowed opens, so a session ledger past the gh-1073
  2 GiB full-open backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path.
  The TUI session picker, `/resume`, and the boot name-resolution scan
  open windowed and resolve the display name through paged reads; the
  subagent transcript preview opens the child windowed (tail only); the
  `_loadSession` marathon fallback no longer degenerates to a refused
  full open when the boundary walk exhausts its page cap (it proceeds
  with the tail-anchored windowed session; the boot cap owns over-window
  residue); and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver opens windowed,
  reading the whole ledger for the cost/inspect views through the new
  `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident` — a sequential forward scan in
  bounded strips (`WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder`), not the
  boundary-walk's doubling strips (whose per-strip record cap measured
  ~13x read/parse amplification over the whole file). The same change
  block-prepends paged chunks in `_indexChunk` (one `insertAll` per
  list), removing an O(n²) the suspended-eviction walk paid per record.
  Trajectory export streaming (AC3a), split-and-retain rotation
  activation (W2), and the opt-in write-side caps (W3) remain follow-up
  work.

  verified when it survives the grader's own invocation: the checklist

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# setup.sh — interactive configuration wizard for the Fa CLI.
#              Run this after `install.sh` to pick a provider, model, API key,
#              mode and approval policy.
#
#                curl -fsSL "https://fa1.dev/setup.sh" | sh
#
# What it does:
#   1. Verifies `fa` is installed.
#   2. Interactively picks a provider + model (or a custom endpoint).
#   3. Collects the API key and writes ~/.fah/config.yaml.
#   4. Optionally persists the API key in your shell startup file.
#
# {{GENERATED_HEADER}}

# gh-1596: this script runs under `curl | sh` — the shebang is dead text and
# whatever `sh` resolves to executes it. POSIX sh only (dash + busybox ash +
# bash): no `printf -v`, no `[[`, no arrays, no `read -p/-a/-N`, no
# `${var,,}`, no `=~`. UT-1 (test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart) lints
# the dialect; UT-2 pins the regenerated bytes.

set -eu  # no pipefail: dash (Ubuntu sh) lacks it

# E4: an unset HOME would die later inside the config path with a bare
# "parameter not set" — fail here, clearly, before anything else runs.
if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then
  printf '\033[1;31m✘\033[0m %s\n' '$HOME is not set — cannot write the Fa config. Set HOME and re-run.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

FAH_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.fah"
FAH_CONFIG_FILE="$FAH_CONFIG_DIR/config.yaml"
FAH_TMP_CONF=""  # config write is atomic (tmp + mv); cleaned on any exit
FAH_STTY_SAVED=""  # termios during hidden reads; restored on any exit

trap 'rm -f "$FAH_TMP_CONF"
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi' EXIT

# ── TTY handling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [ -t 0 ]; then
  FAH_TTY="/dev/stdin"
else
  FAH_TTY="/dev/tty"
fi

# ── Output helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
say() {
  printf '%s\n' "$*"
}

info() {
  printf '\033[1;34m→\033[0m %s\n' "$*"
}

ok() {
  printf '\033[1;32m✔\033[0m %s\n' "$*"
}

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else

    fi
    if ! read -r answer < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
      printf '%s' "$default"
      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1555 (W1, lazy/windowed-everywhere reads): the legacy full-open call
  sites migrate to windowed opens, so a session ledger past the gh-1073
  2 GiB full-open backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path.
  The TUI session picker, `/resume`, and the boot name-resolution scan
  open windowed and resolve the display name through paged reads; the
  subagent transcript preview opens the child windowed (tail only); the
  `_loadSession` marathon fallback no longer degenerates to a refused
  full open when the boundary walk exhausts its page cap (it proceeds
  with the tail-anchored windowed session; the boot cap owns over-window

# whatever `sh` resolves to executes it. POSIX sh only (dash + busybox ash +

}

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-y}" answer
  while true; do
    if [ "$default" = "y" ]; then
      prompt "$text [Y/n]"
    else

    fi
    if ! read -r answer < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
      printf '%s' "$default"
      return 1
    fi
    answer=${answer:-$default}
    case "$answer" in
      [Yy]|"" ) printf 'y\n'; return 0 ;;
      [Nn]    ) printf 'n\n'; return 0 ;;

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1555 (W1, lazy/windowed-everywhere reads): the legacy full-open call
  sites migrate to windowed opens, so a session ledger past the gh-1073
  2 GiB full-open backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path.
  The TUI session picker, `/resume`, and the boot name-resolution scan
  open windowed and resolve the display name through paged reads; the
  subagent transcript preview opens the child windowed (tail only); the
  `_loadSession` marathon fallback no longer degenerates to a refused
  full open when the boundary walk exhausts its page cap (it proceeds
  with the tail-anchored windowed session; the boot cap owns over-window

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1611
- **Title**: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# ── Interactive helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable and never passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

ask_yn() { # ask_yn TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints y or n on stdout

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1555 (W1, lazy/windowed-everywhere reads): the legacy full-open call
  sites migrate to windowed opens, so a session ledger past the gh-1073
  2 GiB full-open backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path.
  The TUI session picker, `/resume`, and the boot name-resolution scan
  open windowed and resolve the display name through paged reads; the
  subagent transcript preview opens the child windowed (tail only); the
  `_loadSession` marathon fallback no longer degenerates to a refused
  full open when the boundary walk exhausts its page cap (it proceeds
  with the tail-anchored windowed session; the boot cap owns over-window
  residue); and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver opens windowed,
  reading the whole ledger for the cost/inspect views through the new
  `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident` — a sequential forward scan in
  bounded strips (`WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder`), not the
  boundary-walk's doubling strips (whose per-strip record cap measured
  ~13x read/parse amplification over the whole file). The same change
  block-prepends paged chunks in `_indexChunk` (one `insertAll` per
  list), removing an O(n²) the suspended-eviction walk paid per record.
  Trajectory export streaming (AC3a), split-and-retain rotation
  activation (W2), and the opt-in write-side caps (W3) remain follow-up
  work.

- gh-1605: the FinalizeGate gains a "grader parity" named check. A

  verified when it survives the grader's own invocation: the checklist

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1611
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1611
- **Title**: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1596` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1834
- **Deletions**: -385
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T14:46:33Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T18:37:44Z

## PR Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# POSIX assignment discipline (gh-1596): `ask`/`ask_yn` print the answer on
# stdout and callers assign via command substitution — `var=$(ask …)` — so
# the exit code propagates (EOF under `set -eu` aborts the wizard, exactly
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -rs "$1"`: the API key moves from the tty straight into the

prompt() {
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m ' "$1" > /dev/tty
}

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout
  local text="$1" default="${2:-}" value
  if [ -n "$default" ]; then
    prompt "$text [$default]"
  else
    prompt "$text"
  fi
  if ! read -r value < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    printf '%s' "$default"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$value" ] && [ -n "$default" ]; then
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
  return 0
}

ask_hidden() { # ask_hidden VAR TEXT — reads hidden input into $VAR by name
  prompt "$2"
  # dash's read has NO -s (probed in the IT platform facts) — hide the
  # entry with stty on the controlling tty instead. `stty -g` snapshots
  # the full termios for a byte-exact restore (the EXIT trap re-runs it,
  # so even Ctrl-C mid-key re-enables echo). The value travels tty →
  # variable BY NAME and never rides printf argv, where ps could catch it.
  if [ -z "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  local read_ok=0
  if read -r "$1" < "$FAH_TTY" 2>/dev/tty; then
    read_ok=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
    FAH_STTY_SAVED=""
  else
    stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi
  printf '\n' > /dev/tty
  [ "$read_ok" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  return 1
}

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1555 (W1, lazy/windowed-everywhere reads): the legacy full-open call
  sites migrate to windowed opens, so a session ledger past the gh-1073
  2 GiB full-open backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path.
  The TUI session picker, `/resume`, and the boot name-resolution scan
  open windowed and resolve the display name through paged reads; the
  subagent transcript preview opens the child windowed (tail only); the
  `_loadSession` marathon fallback no longer degenerates to a refused
  full open when the boundary walk exhausts its page cap (it proceeds
  with the tail-anchored windowed session; the boot cap owns over-window
  residue); and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver opens windowed,
  reading the whole ledger for the cost/inspect views through the new
  `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident` — a sequential forward scan in
  bounded strips (`WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder`), not the
  boundary-walk's doubling strips (whose per-strip record cap measured
  ~13x read/parse amplification over the whole file). The same change
  block-prepends paged chunks in `_indexChunk` (one `insertAll` per
  list), removing an O(n²) the suspended-eviction walk paid per record.
  Trajectory export streaming (AC3a), split-and-retain rotation
  activation (W2), and the opt-in write-side caps (W3) remain follow-up
  work.

- gh-1605: the FinalizeGate gains a "grader parity" named check. A

  verified when it survives the grader's own invocation: the checklist

```sh
mkdir -p "$FAH_CONFIG_DIR"

```

Considerations:
- busybox mktemp: supports `mktemp [-d] [-q] [-t] [-p DIR] [TEMPLATE]` — template form works (needs at least 6 X's? busybox requires the XXX suffix present in template; `.config.yaml.XXXXXX` has 6 X's at the end — good).
- dash on Ubuntu uses GNU coreutils mktemp — fine.
- macOS bash leg: BSD mktemp supports template args — fine.
- Failure handling: under `set -eu`, if mktemp fails, the script aborts — FAH_TMP_CONF stays "" and the trap `rm -f ""` is a no-op. Good.
- `mv -f` over `FAH_CONFIG_FILE` — mktemp creates with 0600 perms, mv preserves them → config.yaml gets 0600 instead of 0644. Acceptable, no secrets inside anyway. Worth a comment noting it.
- The trap cleanup still works: `rm -f "$FAH_TMP_CONF"`.
- `FAH_TMP_CONF=""` reset after mv still fine.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# setup.sh — interactive configuration wizard for the Fa CLI.
#              Run this after `install.sh` to pick a provider, model, API key,
#              mode and approval policy.
#
#                curl -fsSL "https://fa1.dev/setup.sh" | sh
#
# What it does:
#   1. Verifies `fa` is installed.
#   2. Interactively picks a provider + model (or a custom endpoint).
#   3. Collects the API key and writes ~/.fah/config.yaml.
#   4. Optionally persists the API key in your shell startup file.
#
# {{GENERATED_HEADER}}

# gh-1596: this script runs under `curl | sh` — the shebang is dead text and
# whatever `sh` resolves to executes it. POSIX sh only (dash + busybox ash +
# bash): no `printf -v`, no `[[`, no arrays, no `read -p/-a/-N`, no
# `${var,,}`, no `=~`. UT-1 (test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart) lints
# the dialect; UT-2 pins the regenerated bytes.

set -eu  # no pipefail: dash (Ubuntu sh) lacks it

# E4: an unset HOME would die later inside the config path with a bare
# "parameter not set" — fail here, clearly, before anything else runs.
if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then
  printf '\033[1;31m✘\033[0m %s\n' '$HOME is not set — cannot write the Fa config. Set HOME and re-run.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

FAH_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.fah"
FAH_CONFIG_FILE="$FAH_CONFIG_DIR/config.yaml"
FAH_TMP_CONF=""  # config write is atomic (tmp + mv); cleaned on any exit
FAH_STTY_SAVED=""  # termios during hidden reads; restored on any exit

trap 'rm -f "$FAH_TMP_CONF"
  if [ -n "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" ]; then
    stty "$FAH_STTY_SAVED" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
  fi' EXIT

# ── TTY handling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [ -t 0 ]; then
  FAH_TTY="/dev/stdin"
else
  FAH_TTY="/dev/tty"
fi

# ── Output helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
say() {
  printf '%s\n' "$*"
}

info() {
  printf '\033[1;34m→\033[0m %s\n' "$*"
}

ok() {
  printf '\033[1;32m✔\033[0m %s\n' "$*"
}

# pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

ask() { # ask TEXT [DEFAULT] — prints the answer on stdout

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# setup.sh — interactive configuration wizard for the Fa CLI.
#              Run this after `install.sh` to pick a provider, model, API key,
#              mode and approval policy.
#
#                curl -fsSL "https://fa1.dev/setup.sh" | sh
#
# What it does:
#   1. Verifies `fa` is installed.
#   2. Interactively picks a provider + model (or a custom endpoint).
#   3. Collects the API key and writes ~/.fah/config.yaml.
#   4. Optionally persists the API key in your shell startup file.
#
# {{GENERATED_HEADER}}

# gh-1596: this script runs under `curl | sh` — the shebang is dead text and
# whatever `sh` resolves to executes it. POSIX sh only (dash + busybox ash +
# bash): no `printf -v`, no `[[`, no arrays, no `read -p/-a/-N`, no
# `${var,,}`, no `=~`. UT-1 (test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart) lints
# the dialect; UT-2 pins the regenerated bytes.

set -eu  # no pipefail: dash (Ubuntu sh) lacks it

# E4: an unset HOME would die later inside the config path with a bare
# "parameter not set" — fail here, clearly, before anything else runs.
if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then
  printf '\033[1;31m✘\033[0m %s\n' '$HOME is not set — cannot write the Fa config. Set HOME and re-run.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

FAH_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.fah"
FAH_CONFIG_FILE="$FAH_CONFIG_DIR/config.yaml"
FAH_TMP_CONF=""  # config write is atomic (tmp + mv); cleaned on any exit

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `site/setup.sh.template`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: stale `read -rs` claim in the POSIX-discipline comment**

This comment says `ask_hidden` assigns "through `read -rs "$1"`" — but the code directly below deliberately does **not** use `-s` (dash has no `read -s`, as your own IT platform-fact probe pins). The same stale claim also landed in:

- the generated artifact: `site/setup.sh:77` (shipped to every `curl | sh` user),
- the generator docstring: `scripts/gen_installers.dart:323` ("keeps the by-name `read -rs` assignment").

Suggested wording for this block:

```sh
# like the old bare-call + `printf -v` shape). `ask_hidden` assigns BY NAME
# through `read -r "$1"` — the API key moves from the tty straight into the
# variable (echo suppressed via stty — dash has no `read -s`) and never
# passes through printf argv, where `ps` could catch it.
```

Since `site/setup.sh` is golden-pinned, fix the template and rerun
`dart run scripts/gen_installers.dart` so the artifact and the generator
docstring say the same true thing.

---

### Thread 2 — `test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: lint calibration comment contradicts the repo's own platform-fact test**

This docstring line says `read -rs` is "sanctioned by the card — dash/busybox/bash all implement it". That is factually wrong for dash, and the repo now proves the opposite in
`test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart`:

```dart
test('dash read has no -s (why ask_hidden hides via stty)', () {
  final r = Process.runSync('dash', ['-c', 'read -s x < /dev/null']);
  expect(r.exitCode, isNonZero, ...);
});
```

No emitted artifact uses `read -s` anymore (the wizard hides input via
`stty -echo`), so the regex itself is fine — only the justification is
stale. Reword to something like: "`read -s` is not in the forbidden set
only because no artifact uses it; dash has no `-s` — hidden input is done
via `stty -echo` (see `ask_hidden`)".

---

### Thread 3 — `scripts/gen_installers.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` regressed from `dart format`-clean to dirty**

`scripts/gen_installers.dart` is `dart format`-clean on `origin/main`; this PR's heavy edits leave it dirty (here and one more spot — a ternary that fits on one line in main's style). There is no CI format gate, but the repo's pre-commit hook self-heals staged files with `dart format`, so committing unformatted files just moves churn into the next author's staging diff. 9 of the 10 Dart files touched by this PR currently fail `dart format --set-exit-if-changed`.

```bash
dart format scripts/gen_installers.dart \
  test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart \
  test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart \
  test/site/installer_golden_test.dart \

```

Purely cosmetic (the golden test compares template output, not the
generator's own formatting), so no behavior risk.

---

### Thread 4 — `test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: ticket AC3 says the key lands in `config.yaml` exactly once — this (correctly) does not do that**

Ticket gh-1596 AC3 reads: "the hidden API key ... and `~/.fah/config.yaml` contains it exactly once." The implementation — and this assertion — deliberately keep `config.yaml` key-free and persist the key to the shell rc instead, per the settings-registry invariant (issue #288 E1, "secrets never ride the yaml", `lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart:227`). That is the architecturally correct choice, and it matches today's behavior on `main` (the old wizard never wrote the key to the yaml either) — but the deviation from the ticket's literal AC is only documented in test comments.

Please note it explicitly in the PR description (or amend gh-1596's AC3), so the ticket's acceptance record doesn't read as unmet. Everything else about AC3 holds and is well tested: the key appears in exactly one produced file, exactly once, byte-scanned across every file under the fixture HOME.

---

### Thread 5 — `site/setup.sh.template`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):
💡 **SUGGESTION: predictable temp-file name is symlink-followable — `mktemp` is strictly safer**

`FAH_TMP_CONF="$FAH_CONFIG_DIR/.config.yaml.tmp"` is a fixed, predictable path, and the `> "$FAH_TMP_CONF"` redirect follows a pre-planted symlink. A local attacker who can write `$HOME/.fah` before the wizard runs could point that path at another user-writable file and get the config bytes written there. # pr-1611: gh-1596 [GOAL] POSIX-sh portable first-run wizard — setup.sh completes under curl sh on dash/busybox/bash (fixes #1596 crash)

## Description

Closes #1596
### What changed
- Rebuilt the first-run wizard (`site/setup.sh`) as generator-rendered POSIX sh: `scripts/gen_installers.dart` now emits the provider/mode/approval menus from the live catalog, and the template dropped every bashism (`printf -v`, `read -p`, `read -s`) that crashed dash and silently corrupted busybox ash under `curl | sh` (#1596).
- New REG CI leg `installer-portability` (path-triggered on `site/**` + the generator): ubuntu runs dash + busybox ash, macOS runs bash; red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class.

### Key decisions
- Single source of truth: the `/model` TUI presets table (`lib/src/cli/model_presets.dart`, extracted from `provider_models.dart`) now feeds both the CLI menu and the installer menus — the provider/approval data no longer has a second copy in `install-config.yaml`.
- Hidden key entry uses `stty -echo` + by-name `read` (dash has no `read -s`); the key never rides `printf` argv (ps-safe) and is byte-scanned out of every test transcript.
- EOF/Ctrl-C mid-wizard aborts non-zero under `set -eu` — never a half-written `~/.fah`; non-TTY runs print guidance and exit 1.
- Shell-less hosts SKIP their IT cases with named reasons; the CI job installs dash + busybox on ubuntu first (skip-not-fail, macOS pays nothing for dash).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart   # --tags integration
# live, on a terminal:
dash -c 'cat site/setup.sh | dash'
```

> Note: a bare full-suite run on a dev box shows failures in files this PR
> does not touch, all environment-shaped and reproduced on `origin/main`:
> `test/browser_ext/*` needs Chrome for Testing (CI runs them only in
> browser-ext.yml); the `headless_*` / `backend_mode` / `yolo_rm_*` CLI
> integration tests fail when the harness's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` /
> `FA_PROVIDER_*` env leaks into the spawned CLI (they pass with those vars
> unset); `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts in the pty2
> native layer at VM teardown after its 5 tests pass.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CAT[model_presets.dart — live catalog] --> GEN[gen_installers.dart]
  GEN --> T[setup.sh.template — POSIX sh]
  T --> S[site/setup.sh — golden-pinned bytes]
  S -->|curl | sh| DASH[dash / busybox ash / bash — pty IT]
  CI[installer-portability CI leg] -->|red| BLOCK[quality gate blocks merge]
```

</details>

# Changelog
